note.basic_zh:
生命骰：1d12
豁免：力量、體魄
note.basic_en:
Hit Dice: 1d12
Saving Throw: STR, CON
note.lvl01_details_zh:
熟練

• 護甲：輕甲、中甲、盾牌
• 武器：簡易武器、軍用武器
• 技能：從動物馴養、運動、威嚇、自然、觀察、生存中選擇兩項

起始裝備

• 巨斧，或任一軍用近戰武器
• 兩把手斧，或任一簡易武器
• 探險者套組與四把標槍

狂怒

你可用附贈動作進入狂怒。未穿著重甲時，獲得以下效果：

• 力量檢定與力量豁免具有優勢
• 以力量進行近戰武器攻擊並命中時，傷害獲得狂怒加值
• 對鈍擊、穿刺與揮砍傷害具有抗性

狂怒持續 1 分鐘，也可用附贈動作提早結束。狂怒期間無法施法或專注於法術。1 級時，每次長休前可狂怒兩次；次數會隨等級提高。

無甲防禦

未穿著護甲時，護甲等級為 10 + 敏捷調整值 + 體魄調整值。使用盾牌不會失去此效果。
note.lvl01_details_en:
Proficiencies

• Armor: Light armor, medium armor, and shields
• Weapons: Simple and martial weapons
• Skills: Choose two from Animal Handling, Athletics, Intimidation, Nature, Perception, and Survival

Starting Equipment

• A greataxe or any martial melee weapon
• Two handaxes or any simple weapon
• An explorer's pack and four javelins

Rage

You can enter a rage as a bonus action. While not wearing heavy armor, you gain these benefits:

• Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws
• A rage damage bonus when you hit with a melee weapon attack using Strength
• Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage

Rage lasts for 1 minute, and you can also end it early as a bonus action. You cannot cast or concentrate on spells while raging. At 1st level, you can rage twice per long rest; this number increases with level.

Unarmored Defense

While not wearing armor, your Armor Class equals 10 + Dexterity modifier + Constitution modifier. You can still use a shield and gain this benefit.
note.lvl02_details_zh:
危險意識

在第二級，當附近的事物不正常時，你會獲得一種不可思議的感覺，這讓你在躲避危險時獲得優勢。對於你能看到的效果，例如陷阱和法術，你在敏捷豁免檢定上有優勢。為了獲得這種好處，你不能失明、耳聾或喪失能力。

魯莽攻擊

從第 2 級開始，你可以拋開所有防禦的顧慮，進行猛烈的絕望攻擊。當你在回合中進行第一次攻擊時，你可以決定魯莽地攻擊。這樣做可以讓你在本回合使用力量進行近戰武器攻擊檢定時獲得優勢，但對你的攻擊檢定在你的下一個回合之前具有優勢。
note.lvl02_details_en:
Danger Sense

At 2nd level, you gain an uncanny sense of when things nearby aren't as they should be, giving you an edge when you dodge away from danger. You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects that you can see, such as traps and spells. To gain this benefit, you can't be blinded, deafened, or incapacitated.

Reckless Attack

Starting at 2nd level, you can throw aside all concern for defense to attack with fierce desperation. When you make your first attack on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly. Doing so gives you advantage on melee weapon attack rolls using Strength during this turn, but attack rolls against you have advantage until your next turn.
note.lvl03_details_zh:
原始路徑

在第三級，你從可用路徑清單中選擇一條塑造你的憤怒本質的路徑。你的選擇將授予你第 3 級以及第 6、10 和 14 級的功能。
note.lvl03_details_en:
Primal Path

At 3rd level, you choose a path that shapes the nature of your rage from the list of available paths. Your choice grants you features at 3rd level and again at 6th, 10th, and 14th levels.
note.lvl04_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到4級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此功能將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl04_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 4th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl05_details_zh:
額外攻擊

從第 5 級開始，每當你在自己的回合中採取攻擊行動時，你可以攻擊兩次，而不是一次。

快速移動

從第 5 級開始，當你不穿著重甲時，你的速度會增加 10 呎。
note.lvl05_details_en:
Extra Attack

Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

Fast Movement

Starting at 5th level, your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing heavy armor.
note.lvl06_details_zh:
路徑特徵

在第 6 級，你從原始路徑中獲得一項功能。
note.lvl06_details_en:
Path Feature

At 6th level, you gain a feature from your Primal Path.
note.lvl07_details_zh:
野性本能

到了 7 級，你的直覺已經磨練，你在主動擲骰上有優勢。

此外，如果你在戰鬥開始時感到驚訝並且沒有喪失行為能力，那麼你可以在第一個回合中正常行動，但前提是你在該回合中先進入狂暴狀態，然後再做任何其他事情。
note.lvl07_details_en:
Feral Instinct

By 7th level, your instincts are so honed that you have advantage on initiative rolls.

Additionally, if you are surprised at the beginning of combat and aren't incapacitated, you can act normally on your first turn, but only if you enter your rage before doing anything else on that turn.
note.lvl08_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到8級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此功能將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 使用可選專長，你可以選擇一項專長。
note.lvl08_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 8th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM uses the optional Feats, you can instead take a feat.
note.lvl09_details_zh:
殘酷致命 (1 die)

從第 9 級開始，在確定近戰攻擊的致命一擊的額外傷害時，你可以擲出一個額外的武器傷害骰子。

這會在 13 級時增加兩個骰子，在 17 級時增加三個骰子。
note.lvl09_details_en:
Brutal Critical (1 die)

Beginning at 9th level, you can roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack.

This increases to two additional dice at 13th level and three additional dice at 17th level.
note.lvl10_details_zh:
路徑特徵

在第 10 級時，你從原始路徑中獲得一項功能。
note.lvl10_details_en:
Path feature

At 10th level, you gain a feature from your Primal Path.
note.lvl11_details_zh:
無情的憤怒

從 11 級開始，你的狂怒可以讓你在受重傷的情況下繼續戰鬥。如果你在狂暴時生命值降至 0 並且沒有直接死亡，你可以進行 DC 10 的體質豁免。如果你成功了，你的生命值就會降到 1。

第一次使用此功能後，每次使用此功能，DC 都會增加 5。當你完成短暫或長休後，DC 會重設為 10。
note.lvl11_details_en:
Relentless Rage

Starting at 11th level, your rage can keep you fighting despite grievous wounds. If you drop to 0 hit points while you're raging and don't die outright, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. If you succeed, you drop to 1 hit point instead.

Each time you use this feature after the first, the DC increases by 5. When you finish a short or long rest, the DC resets to 10.
note.lvl12_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到12級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此功能將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 使用可選專長，你可以選擇一項專長。
note.lvl12_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 12th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM uses the optional Feats, you can instead take a feat.
note.lvl13_details_zh:
殘酷關鍵（2 顆骰子）

現在，在確定近戰攻擊的致命一擊的額外傷害時，你可以擲兩個額外的武器傷害骰子。
note.lvl13_details_en:
Brutal Critical (2 dice)

You now roll two additional weapon damage dice when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack.
note.lvl14_details_zh:
路徑特徵

在 14 級時，你從原始路徑中獲得一項功能。
note.lvl14_details_en:
Path feature

At 14th level, you gain a feature from your Primal Path.
note.lvl15_details_zh:
持續的憤怒

從 15 級開始，你的狂暴如此猛烈，只有當你失去知覺或選擇結束它時，它才會提前結束。
note.lvl15_details_en:
Persistent Rage

Beginning at 15th level, your rage is so fierce that it ends early only if you fall unconscious or if you choose to end it.
note.lvl16_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到16級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此功能將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 使用可選專長，你可以選擇一項專長。
note.lvl16_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 16th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM uses the optional Feats, you can instead take a feat.
note.lvl17_details_zh:
殘酷關鍵（3 顆骰子）

現在，在確定近戰攻擊的致命一擊的額外傷害時，你可以擲出三個額外的武器傷害骰子。
note.lvl17_details_en:
Brutal Critical (3 dice)

You now roll three additional weapon damage dice when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack.
note.lvl18_details_zh:
不屈不撓的力量

從 18 級開始，如果你的力量檢定總分低於你的力量分數，你可以使用該分數來代替總分。
note.lvl18_details_en:
Indomitable Might

Beginning at 18th level, if your total for a Strength check is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.
note.lvl19_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到19級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此功能將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 使用可選專長，你可以選擇一項專長。
note.lvl19_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM uses the optional Feats, you can instead take a feat.
note.lvl20_details_zh:
原始冠軍

20級時，你體現了荒野的力量。你的力量和體質分數增加 4。你這些分數的最大值現在為 24。
note.lvl20_details_en:
Primal Champion

At 20th level, you embody the power of the wilds. Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4. Your maximum for those scores is now 24.

note.basic_zh:
生命骰：1d8
豁免：敏捷、魅力
note.basic_en:
Hit Dice: 1d8
Saving Throw: DEX, CHA
note.lvl01_details_zh:
熟練

• 護甲：輕甲
• 武器：簡易武器、手弩、長劍、細劍、短劍
• 工具：任選三種樂器
• 技能：任選三項

起始裝備

• 細劍、長劍或任一簡易武器
• 外交官套組或藝人套組
• 魯特琴或任一樂器
• 皮甲與匕首

施法

• 施法能力：魅力
• 法術豁免 DC：8 + 熟練加值 + 魅力調整值
• 法術攻擊加值：熟練加值 + 魅力調整值
• 戲法：從吟遊詩人法術表選擇兩個
• 1 環法術：從吟遊詩人法術表選擇四個
• 升級時，可將一個已知法術替換為另一個符合條件的吟遊詩人法術
• 可使用樂器作為施法法器

吟遊激勵

吟遊激勵的使用次數等於魅力調整值，至少一次，完成長休後恢復。你可用附贈動作選擇 60 呎內一名能聽見你的其他生物；該生物在 10 分鐘內可將一顆吟遊激勵骰（1 級時為 d6）加到一次能力檢定、攻擊檢定或豁免結果中。
note.lvl01_details_en:
Proficiencies

• Armor: Light armor
• Weapons: Simple weapons, hand crossbows, longswords, rapiers, and shortswords
• Tools: Three musical instruments of your choice
• Skills: Any three

Starting Equipment

• A rapier, longsword, or any simple weapon
• A diplomat's pack or entertainer's pack
• A lute or any other musical instrument
• Leather armor and a dagger

Spellcasting

• Spellcasting Ability: Charisma
• Spell Save DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier
• Spell Attack Modifier: proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier
• Cantrips: Choose two from the bard spell list
• 1st-Level Spells: Choose four from the bard spell list
• When you gain a level, you can replace one known spell with another eligible bard spell
• You can use a musical instrument as a spellcasting focus

Bardic Inspiration

You can use Bardic Inspiration a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier, with a minimum of once, and regain all uses after a long rest. As a bonus action, choose another creature within 60 feet that can hear you. Within 10 minutes, it can add one Bardic Inspiration die—a d6 at 1st level—to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.
note.lvl02_details_zh:
萬事通

從第 2 級開始，你可以將一半的熟練加值（向下舍入）添加到你進行的任何不包括熟練加值的能力檢查中。

安息之歌 (d6)

從第 2 級開始，你可以在短休期間使用舒緩的音樂或演講來幫助受傷的盟友恢復活力。如果你或任何能聽到你表演的友方生物在短休結束時透過花費生命骰來恢復生命值，那麼每個生物都會額外恢復 1d6 生命值。

當你達到該職業的特定等級時，額外生命值會增加：9級時增加到1d8，13級時增加到1d10，17級時增加到1d12。
note.lvl02_details_en:
Jack of All Trades

Starting at 2nd level, you can add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

Song of Rest (d6)

Beginning at 2nd level, you can use soothing music or oration to help revitalize your wounded allies during a short rest. If you or any friendly creatures who can hear your performance regain hit points by spending Hit Dice at the end of the short rest, each of those creatures regains an extra 1d6 hit points.

The extra hit points increase when you reach certain levels in this class: to 1d8 at 9th level, to 1d10 at 13th level, and to 1d12 at 17th level.
note.lvl03_details_zh:
巴德學院

在第三級，你可以從可用學院清單中深入研究你選擇的吟遊詩人學院的先進技術。你的選擇將授予你第 3 級以及第 6 級和第 14 級的功能。

專業知識

在第 3 級，選擇你的兩項技能熟練程度。對於你使用任一所選熟練程度進行的任何能力檢查，你的熟練加值都會加倍。

在 10 級時，你可以選擇另外兩種技能熟練程度來獲得此好處。
note.lvl03_details_en:
Bard College

At 3rd level, you delve into the advanced techniques of a bard college of your choice from the list of available colleges. Your choice grants you features at 3rd level and again at 6th and 14th level.

Expertise

At 3rd level, choose two of your skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies.

At 10th level, you can choose another two skill proficiencies to gain this benefit.
note.lvl04_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到4級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此功能將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl04_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 4th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl05_details_zh:
吟遊詩人的靈感 (d8)

在第 5 級，你的吟遊詩人靈感骰子變成 d8。

靈感字體

從你達到第 5 級開始，當你完成短期或長期休息時，你會恢復所有已消耗的吟遊詩人靈感的使用量。
note.lvl05_details_en:
Bardic Inspiration (d8)

At 5th level, your Bardic Inspiration die changes to a d8.

Font of Inspiration

Beginning when you reach 5th level, you regain all of your expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a short or long rest.
note.lvl06_details_zh:
反魅惑

在第 6 級，你獲得使用音符或力量話語來破壞影響心靈的效果的能力。作為一個動作，你可以開始一場持續到下一個回合結束的表演。在此期間，你和周圍 30 呎內的任何友方生物在對抗驚嚇或魅惑的豁免檢定上都有優勢。生物必須能夠聽到你的聲音才能獲得此好處。如果你喪失行為能力或保持沉默，或者你自願結束表演（無需採取任何行動），表演將提前結束。

巴德學院特色

在第 6 級，你將獲得巴德學院的一項功能。
note.lvl06_details_en:
Countercharm

At 6th level, you gain the ability to use musical notes or words of power to disrupt mind-influencing effects. As an action, you can start a performance that lasts until the end of your next turn. During that time, you and any friendly creatures within 30 feet of you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed. A creature must be able to hear you to gain this benefit. The performance ends early if you are incapacitated or silenced or if you voluntarily end it (no action required).

Bard College feature

At 6th level, you gain a feature from your Bard College.
note.lvl08_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到8級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。正常情況下，你不能使用此功能將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl08_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 8th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl09_details_zh:
安息之歌 (d8)

9級時，從《安息之歌》中獲得的額外生命值增加至1d8。
note.lvl09_details_en:
Song of Rest (d8)

At 9th level, the extra hit points gained from Song of Rest increases to 1d8.
note.lvl10_details_zh:
吟遊詩人的靈感 (d10)

在 10 級時，你的吟遊詩人靈感骰子變成 d10。

專業知識

10級時，你可以選擇另外兩種技能熟練度。對於你使用任一所選熟練程度進行的任何能力檢查，你的熟練加值都會加倍。

神奇的秘密

到了 10 級，你已經從廣泛的學科中掠奪了魔法知識。從任意類別中選擇兩個法術，包括這個。你選擇的咒語必須達到你可以施展的等級，如吟遊詩人表或戲法上所示。

所選法術對你來說算是吟遊詩人法術，並包含在吟遊詩人表的已知法術列中的數字中。

你可以在 14 級從任何職業學習兩個額外的法術，並在 18 級再次學習。
note.lvl10_details_en:
Bardic Inspiration (d10)

At 10th level, your Bardic Inspiration die changes to a d10.

Expertise

At 10th level, you can choose another two skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies.

Magical Secrets

By 10th level, you have plundered magical knowledge from a wide spectrum of disciplines. Choose two spells from any class, including this one. A spell you choose must be of a level you can cast, as shown on the Bard table, or a cantrip.

The chosen spells count as bard spells for you and are included in the number in the Spells Known column of the Bard table.

You learn two additional spells from any class at 14th level and again at 18th level.
note.lvl12_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到12級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此功能將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。

熟練

• 技能：從歷史、察言觀色、醫藥、遊說、宗教中選擇兩項

起始裝備

• 錘矛，或戰錘（若具有熟練）

• 法術攻擊加值：熟練加值 + 感知調整值
• 戲法：從牧師法術表選擇三個
• 1 級時擁有兩個 1 環法術位
• 每日準備的牧師法術數量為 感知調整值 + 牧師等級，至少一個；只能準備你擁有相應法術位環級的法術
• 可使用聖徽作為施法法器

神聖領域

選擇一個與信奉神祇相關的領域：知識、生命、光明、自然、風暴、詭術或戰爭。領域法術會自動準備，且不計入每日準備法術數量；升級後還會取得該領域的其他能力。

Spellcasting

• Spellcasting Ability: Wisdom
• Spell Save DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier
• Spell Attack Modifier: proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier
• Cantrips: Choose three from the cleric spell list
• At 1st level, you have two 1st-level spell slots
• You prepare Wisdom modifier + cleric level cleric spells each day, with a minimum of one. You can prepare only spells for which you have spell slots
• You can use a holy symbol as a spellcasting focus

Divine Domain

Choose a domain associated with your deity: Knowledge, Life, Light, Nature, Tempest, Trickery, or War. Domain spells are always prepared and do not count against the number you prepare each day. Your domain also grants additional features as you gain levels.
note.lvl02_details_zh:
引導神性（1/休息）

在第2級，你獲得直接從你的神靈引導神聖能量的能力，使用該能量來增強魔法效果。你從兩個這樣的效果開始：驅散亡靈和由你的領域決定的效果。某些領域會隨著你等級的提升而授予你額外的效果，如領域描述中所述。

當你使用通道神性時，你可以選擇要建立的效果。然後，你必須完成短暫或長時間的休息才能再次使用你的通道神性。

某些引導神性效果需要豁免檢定。當你使用此類效果時，DC 等於你的牧師法術豁免 DC。

從 6 級開始，你可以在休息之間使用神通兩次，從 18 級開始，你可以在休息之間使用 3 次。當你完成短暫或長時間的休息後，你將恢復消耗的使用量。

轉亡靈

作為一個動作，你展示你的聖徽並說出譴責不死生物的祈禱文。每個在你周圍 30 呎內能看到或聽到你的不死生物都必須進行一次感知豁免。如果生物未能通過豁免檢定，它將被翻轉 1 分鐘或直到受到任何傷害。

一個變身的生物必須花很多時間嘗試移動到離你盡可能遠的地方，而且它不能自願移動到距離你 30 呎以內的空間。它也無法做出反應。對於其動作，它只能使用衝刺動作或嘗試逃離阻止其移動的效果。如果無處可移動，則該生物可以使用閃避動作。

神域特色

在第 2 級，你獲得了神域的一項功能。
note.lvl02_details_en:
Channel Divinity (1/rest)

At 2nd level, you gain the ability to channel divine energy directly from your deity, using that energy to fuel magical effects. You start with two such effects: Turn Undead and an effect determined by your domain. Some domains grant you additional effects as you advance in levels, as noted in the domain description.

When you use your Channel Divinity, you choose which effect to create. You must then finish a short or long rest to use your Channel Divinity again.

Some Channel Divinity effects require saving throws. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your cleric spell save DC.

Beginning at 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity twice between rests, and beginning at 18th level, you can use it three times between rests. When you finish a short or long rest, you regain your expended uses.

Turn Undead

As an action, you present your holy symbol and speak a prayer censuring the undead. Each undead that can see or hear you within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes any damage.

A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the Dodge action.

Divine Domain feature

At 2nd level, you gain a feature from your Divine Domain.

note.lvl10_details_en:

Beginning at 10th level, you can call on your deity to intervene on your behalf when your need is great.

Imploring your deity's aid requires you to use your action. Describe the assistance you seek, and roll percentile dice. If you roll a number equal to or lower than your cleric level, your deity intervenes. The DM chooses the nature of the intervention; the effect of any cleric spell or cleric domain spell would be appropriate. If your deity intervenes, you can't use this feature again for 7 days. Otherwise, you can use it again after you finish a long rest.

At 20th level, your call for intervention succeeds automatically, no roll required.

You know Druidic and can use it to speak or leave secret messages. Creatures that know Druidic notice such messages automatically. Others must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice one and cannot decipher it without magic.

野性變身

從第 2 級開始，你可以用你的行動神奇地呈現你以前見過的野獸的形狀。你可以使用此功能兩次。當你完成短暫或長時間的休息後，你將恢復已消耗的用途。

你的德魯伊等級決定了你可以變身的野獸，如野獸形狀表中所示。例如，在第 2 級，你可以變身為任何挑戰等級為 1/4 或更低但沒有飛行或游泳速度的野獸。

你可以保持野獸形態的時間等於你德魯伊等級的一半（向下舍入）。然後你將恢復到正常形式，除非你再次使用此功能。你可以透過在你的回合中使用附贈動作來提前恢復到正常狀態。如果你失去知覺、生命值降至 0 或死亡，你會自動恢復。

當你轉變時，以下規則適用：

• 你的遊戲統計數據會被野獸的統計數據所取代，但你會保留你的陣營、個性以及智力、感知和魅力分數。除了獲得該生物的技能和豁免能力之外，你還保留了所有技能和豁免能力。如果該生物與你具有相同的熟練度，並且其屬性塊中的加值高於你的，則使用該生物的加值而不是你的。如果生物具有任何傳奇或巢穴動作，則你無法使用它們。
• 當你變形時，你會假設野獸的生命值和生命骰。當你恢復正常形態時，你的生命值會恢復到變身前的水準。然而，如果你因生命值降至 0 而恢復，任何多餘的傷害都會轉入你的正常形態。例如，如果你在動物形態下受到 10 點傷害並且只剩下 1 點生命值，那麼你會恢復並受到 9 點傷害。只要超額傷害不會將你正常形態的生命值降低至 0，你就不會被擊昏。
• 你不能施展法術，並且你說話或採取任何需要雙手的行動的能力都受到你野獸形態的能力的限制。然而，變形並不會破壞你對已經施展的法術的注意力，也不會阻止你採取屬於法術一部分的動作，例如你已經施展的召喚閃電。
• 你保留了來自你的階級、種族或其他來源的任何功能的好處，並且可以使用它們（如果新形態在身體上有能力這樣做的話）。然而，你不能使用任何特殊感官，例如黑暗視覺，除非你的新形態也有這種感覺。
• 你可以選擇你的裝備是掉落在你所在空間的地面上、融入你的新形態還是被它磨損。磨損的裝備可以正常工作，但 DM 根據生物的形狀和大小來決定新形態佩戴一件裝備是否實用。你的裝備不會改變尺寸或形狀來匹配新形態，並且新形態無法穿戴的任何裝備都必須掉落到地面或與其合併。與形態融合的裝備在你離開形態之前不會產生任何效果。

德魯伊圓環

在第 2 級，你可以從可用圈子清單中選擇認同德魯伊圈子。你的選擇將授予你 2 級以及 6、10 和 14 級的功能。
note.lvl02_details_en:
Wild Shape

Starting at 2nd level, you can use your action to magically assume the shape of a beast that you have seen before. You can use this feature twice. You regain expended uses when you finish a short or long rest.

Your druid level determines the beasts you can transform into, as shown in the Beast Shapes table. At 2nd level, for example, you can transform into any beast that has a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower that doesn't have a flying or swimming speed.

| Level | Max. CR | Limitations | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bestiary|cr=0;1/8;1/4|type=beast|speed=!fly;!swim|miscellaneous=!swarm | 1/4 | No flying or swimming speed | Wolf |
| bestiary|cr=0;1/8;1/4;1/2|type=beast|speed=!fly|miscellaneous=!swarm | 1/2 | No flying speed | Crocodile |
| bestiary|cr=0;1/8;1/4;1/2;1|type=beast|speed=null|miscellaneous=!swarm | 1 | — | Giant eagle |

You can stay in a beast shape for a number of hours equal to half your druid level (rounded down). You then revert to your normal form unless you expend another use of this feature. You can revert to your normal form earlier by using a bonus action on your turn. You automatically revert if you fall unconscious, drop to 0 hit points, or die.

While you are transformed, the following rules apply:

• Your game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the beast, but you retain your alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You also retain all of your skill and saving throw proficiencies, in addition to gaining those of the creature. If the creature has the same proficiency as you and the bonus in its stat block is higher than yours, use the creature's bonus instead of yours. If the creature has any legendary or lair actions, you can't use them.
• When you transform, you assume the beast's hit points and Hit Dice. When you revert to your normal form, you return to the number of hit points you had before you transformed. However, if you revert as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to your normal form. For example, if you take 10 damage in animal form and have only 1 hit point left, you revert and take 9 damage. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce your normal form to 0 hit points, you aren't knocked unconscious.
• You can't cast spells, and your ability to speak or take any action that requires hands is limited to the capabilities of your beast form. Transforming doesn't break your concentration on a spell you've already cast, however, or prevent you from taking actions that are part of a spell, such as call lightning, that you've already cast.
• You retain the benefit of any features from your class, race, or other source and can use them if the new form is physically capable of doing so. However, you can't use any of your special senses, such as darkvision, unless your new form also has that sense.
• You choose whether your equipment falls to the ground in your space, merges into your new form, or is worn by it. Worn equipment functions as normal, but the DM decides whether it is practical for the new form to wear a piece of equipment, based on the creature's shape and size. Your equipment doesn't change size or shape to match the new form, and any equipment that the new form can't wear must either fall to the ground or merge with it. Equipment that merges with the form has no effect until you leave the form.

Druid Circle

At 2nd level, you choose to identify with a circle of druids from the list of available circles. Your choice grants you features at 2nd level and again at 6th, 10th, and 14th level.

17級時，你可以在長休之間使用不屈3次。
note.lvl17_details_en:
Action Surge (two uses)

At 17th level, you can use Action Surge twice before a rest, but only once on the same turn.

Indomitable (three uses)

At 17th level, you can use Indomitable three times between long rests.
note.lvl18_details_zh:
武術原型特徵

在 18 級時，你獲得了你的武術原型所賦予的功能。
note.lvl18_details_en:
Martial Archetype feature

At 18th level, you gain a feature granted by your Martial Archetype.
note.lvl19_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到19級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此功能將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl19_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 19th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl20_details_zh:
額外攻擊 (3)

在20級時，每當你在回合中採取攻擊行動時，你可以攻擊四次。
note.lvl20_details_en:
Extra Attack (3)

At 20th level, you can attack four times whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

note.basic_zh:
生命骰：1d8
豁免：力量、敏捷
note.basic_en:
Hit Dice: 1d8
Saving Throw: STR, DEX
note.lvl01_details_zh:
熟練

• 武器：簡易武器、短劍
• 工具：任一工匠工具或樂器
• 技能：從體操、運動、歷史、察言觀色、宗教、隱匿中選擇兩項

起始裝備

• 短劍，或任一簡易武器
• 地城探索者套組或探險者套組
• 10 枚飛鏢

無甲防禦

未穿著護甲且未持盾牌時，護甲等級為 10 + 敏捷調整值 + 感知調整值。

武術

未穿著護甲、未持盾牌，且僅空手或持用武僧武器時：

• 可用敏捷取代力量進行空手與武僧武器的攻擊及傷害擲骰
• 可用 d4 取代空手與武僧武器的原始傷害骰；此骰會隨等級提高
• 在攻擊動作中使用空手或武僧武器後，可用附贈動作再進行一次空手攻擊

武僧武器包括短劍，以及不具雙手或重型屬性的簡易近戰武器。
note.lvl01_details_en:
Proficiencies

• Weapons: Simple weapons and shortswords
• Tools: One artisan's tool or musical instrument of your choice
• Skills: Choose two from Acrobatics, Athletics, History, Insight, Religion, and Stealth

Starting Equipment

• A shortsword or any simple weapon
• A dungeoneer's pack or explorer's pack
• 10 darts

Unarmored Defense

While not wearing armor or wielding a shield, your Armor Class equals 10 + Dexterity modifier + Wisdom modifier.

Martial Arts

While unarmored, not wielding a shield, and using only unarmed strikes or monk weapons:

• You can use Dexterity instead of Strength for attack and damage rolls with unarmed strikes and monk weapons
• You can use a d4 in place of the normal damage die for unarmed strikes and monk weapons; this die increases with level
• After using an unarmed strike or monk weapon as part of the Attack action, you can make one unarmed strike as a bonus action

Monk weapons are shortswords and simple melee weapons without the two-handed or heavy property.
note.lvl02_details_zh:
氣

從第二級開始，你的訓練可以讓你利用氣的神秘能量。你對這種能量的獲取由 ki 點的數量表示。你的武僧等級決定了你擁有的點數，如武僧表的 Ki 點數 列所示。

你可以使用這些積分來增強各種 ki 功能。你開始了解三個這樣的功能：連擊、耐心防禦和風之步。當你在本課程中獲得等級時，你會學到更多的 ki 功能。

當你消耗氣點時，只有在完成短暫或長時間的休息後才能使用，休息結束後，你將所有消耗的氣重新吸回體內。剩下的時間你必須花至少 30 分鐘冥想才能恢復你的氣點。

你的一些氣特性要求你的目標進行一次豁免檢定來抵抗該特性的效果。豁免DC計算如下：

能力DC：8+熟練加值+感知調整值

連續打擊

在你的回合中採取攻擊行動後，你可以立即花費 1 點氣進行兩次徒手攻擊作為附贈動作。

病人辯護

你可以花費 1 點氣來採取閃避動作，作為你回合的附贈動作。

風之步

你可以花費 1 點氣來採取脫離或衝刺動作作為你回合的附贈動作，並且你的跳躍距離在該回合加倍。

非裝甲運動

從 2 級開始，當你不穿著盔甲或揮舞盾牌時，你的速度會增加 10 呎。當你達到一定的武僧等級時，此獎勵會增加，如武僧表中所示。

在第 9 級，你能夠在輪流中沿著垂直表面移動並穿過液體，而不會在移動過程中跌倒。
note.lvl02_details_en:
Ki

Starting at 2nd level, your training allows you to harness the mystic energy of ki. Your access to this energy is represented by a number of ki points. Your monk level determines the number of points you have, as shown in the Ki Points column of the Monk table.

You can spend these points to fuel various ki features. You start knowing three such features: Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind. You learn more ki features as you gain levels in this class.

When you spend a ki point, it is unavailable until you finish a short or long rest, at the end of which you draw all of your expended ki back into yourself. You must spend at least 30 minutes of the rest meditating to regain your ki points.

Some of your ki features require your target to make a saving throw to resist the feature's effects. The saving throw DC is calculated as follows:

Ability DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + wis modifier

Flurry of Blows

Immediately after you take the Attack action on your turn, you can spend 1 ki point to make two unarmed strikes as a bonus action.

Patient Defense

You can spend 1 ki point to take the Dodge action as a bonus action on your turn.

Step of the Wind

You can spend 1 ki point to take the Disengage or Dash action as a bonus action on your turn, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn.

Unarmored Movement

Starting at 2nd level, your speed increases by 10 feet while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield. This bonus increases when you reach certain monk levels, as shown in the Monk table.

At 9th level, you gain the ability to move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling during the move.
note.lvl03_details_zh:
偏轉導彈

從第 3 級開始，當你被遠程武器攻擊擊中時，你可以利用你的反應來偏轉或捕獲導彈。當你這樣做時，你受到的攻擊傷害會減少 1d10 + 你的敏捷調整值 + 你的武僧等級。

如果將傷害降低到 0，並且導彈足夠小，可以用一隻手握住，並且你至少有一隻手空閒，那麼你就可以抓住導彈。如果你以這種方式捕獲導彈，你可以花費 1 ki 點使用你剛剛捕獲的武器或彈藥進行遠程攻擊（範圍 20/60 呎），作為同一反應的一部分。無論你的武器熟練程度如何，你都會熟練地進行這次攻擊，並且導彈算作這次攻擊的武僧武器。

修道院傳統

當你達到第三級時，你將致力於從可用傳統清單中選擇的修道院傳統。你的傳統賦予你第 3 級以及第 6、11 和 17 級的功能。
note.lvl03_details_en:
Deflect Missiles

Starting at 3rd level, you can use your reaction to deflect or catch the missile when you are hit by a ranged weapon attack. When you do so, the damage you take from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier + your monk level.

If you reduce the damage to 0, you can catch the missile if it is small enough for you to hold in one hand and you have at least one hand free. If you catch a missile in this way, you can spend 1 ki point to make a ranged attack (range 20/60 feet) with the weapon or piece of ammunition you just caught, as part of the same reaction. You make this attack with proficiency, regardless of your weapon proficiencies, and the missile counts as a monk weapon for the attack.

Monastic Tradition

When you reach 3rd level, you commit yourself to a monastic tradition, chosen from the list of available traditions. Your tradition grants you features at 3rd level and again at 6th, 11th, and 17th level.
note.lvl04_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到4級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此功能將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。

緩慢下降

從 4 級開始，你可以在跌倒時使用你的反應來減少你受到的跌倒傷害，傷害值相當於你武僧等級的五倍。
note.lvl04_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 4th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.

Slow Fall

Beginning at 4th level, you can use your reaction when you fall to reduce any falling damage you take by an amount equal to five times your monk level.
note.lvl05_details_zh:
額外攻擊

從第 5 級開始，每當你在自己的回合中採取攻擊行動時，你可以攻擊兩次，而不是一次。

驚人一擊

從第 5 級開始，你可以乾擾對手體內的氣流。當你用近戰武器攻擊擊中另一個生物時，你可以花費 1 點氣來嘗試一次驚人的攻擊。目標必須成功通過體質豁免，否則將被眩暈直到你的下一個回合結束。
note.lvl05_details_en:
Extra Attack

Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

Stunning Strike

Starting at 5th level, you can interfere with the flow of ki in an opponent's body. When you hit another creature with a melee weapon attack, you can spend 1 ki point to attempt a stunning strike. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn.
note.lvl06_details_zh:
氣強化攻擊

從等級 6 開始，為了克服對非魔法攻擊和傷害的抵抗和免疫，你的徒手攻擊算作魔法攻擊。

寺院傳統特色

在第 6 級，你獲得了修道院傳統所授予的一項功能。
note.lvl06_details_en:
Ki-Empowered Strikes

Starting at 6th level, your unarmed strikes count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

Monastic Tradition feature

At 6th level, you gain one feature granted by your Monastic Tradition.
note.lvl07_details_zh:
閃避

在 7 級時，你本能的敏捷性可以讓你躲避某些區域效果，例如藍龍的閃電吐息或火球術。當你受到允許你進行敏捷豁免檢定僅受到一半傷害的效果時，如果你豁免檢定成功，你將不會受到任何傷害，如果你失敗，你只會受到一半傷害。

心靈的寧靜

從第 7 級開始，你可以用你的行動來結束對你自己造成的一種導致你被魅惑或恐懼的效果。
note.lvl07_details_en:
Evasion

At 7th level, your instinctive agility lets you dodge out of the way of certain area effects, such as a blue dragon's lightning breath or a fireball spell. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

Stillness of Mind

Starting at 7th level, you can use your action to end one effect on yourself that is causing you to be charmed or frightened.
note.lvl08_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到8級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。正常情況下，你不能使用此功能將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl08_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 8th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl09_details_zh:
非裝甲運動改進

在第 9 級，你能夠在輪流中沿著垂直表面移動並穿過液體，而不會在移動過程中跌倒。
note.lvl09_details_en:
Unarmored Movement improvement

At 9th level, you gain the ability to move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling during the move.
note.lvl10_details_zh:
身體的純淨

10級時，你對流經體內的氣的掌握使你免疫疾病和毒藥。
note.lvl10_details_en:
Purity of Body

At 10th level, your mastery of the ki flowing through you makes you immune to disease and poison.
note.lvl11_details_zh:
寺院傳統特色

在第 11 級，你獲得了一項由你的修道院傳統授予的功能。
note.lvl11_details_en:
Monastic Tradition feature

At 11th level, you gain one feature granted by your Monastic Tradition.
note.lvl12_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到12級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此功能將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl12_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 12th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl13_details_zh:
日月之舌

從第 13 級開始，你學習接觸他人心靈的“氣”，以便理解所有口語。此外，任何能夠理解語言的生物都可以理解你所說的話。
note.lvl13_details_en:
Tongue of the Sun and Moon

Starting at 13th level, you learn to touch the ki of other minds so that you understand all spoken languages. Moreover, any creature that can understand a language can understand what you say.
note.lvl14_details_zh:
鑽石之魂

從 14 級開始，你對氣的掌握使你精通所有豁免檢定。

此外，每當你進行豁免檢定並失敗時，你可以花費 1 點氣重新投擲並獲得第二個結果。
note.lvl14_details_en:
Diamond Soul

Beginning at 14th level, your mastery of ki grants you proficiency in all saving throws.

Additionally, whenever you make a saving throw and fail, you can spend 1 ki point to reroll it and take the second result.
note.lvl15_details_zh:
永恆的身體

在15級時，你的氣會支撐你，這樣你就不會遭受年老時的虛弱之苦，而且你也不會神奇地變老。然而，你仍然可能因年老而死亡。此外，你不再需要食物或水。
note.lvl15_details_en:
Timeless Body

At 15th level, your ki sustains you so that you suffer none of the frailty of old age, and you can't be aged magically. You can still die of old age, however. In addition, you no longer need food or water.
note.lvl16_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到16級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此功能將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl16_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 16th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl17_details_zh:
寺院傳統特色

在第 17 級，你獲得了一項由你的修道院傳統授予的功能。
note.lvl17_details_en:
Monastic Tradition feature

At 17th level, you gain one feature granted by your Monastic Tradition.
note.lvl18_details_zh:
空身

從 18 級開始，你可以用你的行動花費 4 點氣來隱形 1 分鐘。在此期間，你還可以抵抗除力力傷害之外的所有傷害。

此外，你可以花費8點氣來施放星體投射法術，而不需要材料成分。當你這樣做時，你不能帶走任何其他生物。
note.lvl18_details_en:
Empty Body

Beginning at 18th level, you can use your action to spend 4 ki points to become invisible for 1 minute. During that time, you also have resistance to all damage but force damage.

Additionally, you can spend 8 ki points to cast the astral projection spell, without needing material components. When you do so, you can't take any other creatures with you.
note.lvl19_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到19級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此功能將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl19_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 19th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl20_details_zh:
完美靈魂

在20級，當你投出主動權並且沒有剩餘氣點時，你會恢復4點氣。
note.lvl20_details_en:
Perfect Soul

At 20th level, when you roll for initiative and have no ki points remaining, you regain 4 ki points.

note.basic_zh:
生命骰：1d10
豁免：感知、魅力
note.basic_en:
Hit Dice: 1d10
Saving Throw: WIS, CHA
note.lvl01_details_zh:
熟練

• 護甲：所有護甲、盾牌
• 武器：簡易武器、軍用武器
• 技能：從運動、察言觀色、威嚇、醫藥、遊說、宗教中選擇兩項

起始裝備

• 一把軍用武器與一面盾牌，或兩把軍用武器
• 五把標槍，或任一簡易近戰武器
• 祭司套組或探險者套組
• 鎖子甲與聖徽

神聖感知

使用動作後，直到下回合結束前，你會知道 60 呎內未受全身掩蔽的天界生物、邪魔與不死生物的位置及類型，但無法得知個體身分。你也能感知範圍內受聖化或褻瀆的地點或物品。每次長休前可使用 1 + 魅力調整值 次，至少一次。

聖療

你擁有等於 聖騎士等級 × 5 的治療池。可用動作觸碰生物並消耗池中點數，恢復等量生命值；也可消耗 5 點治癒一種疾病或中和一種毒素。此能力對不死生物與構裝生物無效，完成長休後恢復治療池。
note.lvl01_details_en:
Proficiencies

• Armor: All armor and shields
• Weapons: Simple and martial weapons
• Skills: Choose two from Athletics, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, Persuasion, and Religion

Starting Equipment

• One martial weapon and a shield, or two martial weapons
• Five javelins or any simple melee weapon
• A priest's pack or explorer's pack
• Chain mail and a holy symbol

Divine Sense

As an action, until the end of your next turn, you know the location and type of any celestial, fiend, or undead within 60 feet that is not behind total cover, but not its identity. You also detect consecrated or desecrated places or objects in range. You can use this feature 1 + Charisma modifier times per long rest, with a minimum of once.

Lay on Hands

You have a healing pool equal to paladin level × 5. As an action, touch a creature and spend points from the pool to restore that many hit points. You can instead spend 5 points to cure one disease or neutralize one poison. This feature has no effect on undead or constructs, and the pool replenishes after a long rest.
note.lvl02_details_zh:
神聖之擊

從第 2 級開始，當你用近戰武器攻擊擊中生物時，除了武器傷害之外，你還可以花費一個法術位對目標造成光輝傷害。 1級法術位的額外傷害為2d8，每高於1級的法術位額外傷害1d8，最多為5d8。如果目標是不死族或惡魔，則傷害增加 1d8。

戰鬥風格

你採用特定的戰鬥風格作為你的專長。從選用功能清單中選擇一種戰鬥風格。即使你可以再次選擇，你也不能多次選擇相同的戰鬥風格選項。

選擇以下選項之一：

近距離射擊

當你在敵對生物 5 呎範圍內進行遠程攻擊時，你在攻擊檢定上不會處於劣勢。你的遠程攻擊會忽略對你 30 呎內目標的半掩護和四分之三掩護。你在遠程攻擊時的攻擊檢定有+1加值。

防禦

當你穿著盔甲時，你的AC獲得+1加值。

決鬥

當你一手揮舞近戰武器而沒有其他武器時，你使用該武器的傷害檢定獲得+2加值。

偉大的武器戰鬥

當你使用兩隻手揮舞的近戰武器進行攻擊時，在傷害骰子上擲出 1 或 2 時，你可以重新擲骰子，並且必須使用新的骰子。該武器必須具有雙手或多用途屬性才能獲得此好處。

水手

只要你沒有穿著重甲或使用盾牌，你的游泳速度和攀爬速度就等於你的正常速度，而且你的AC獲得+1加值。

保護

當你能看到的生物攻擊距離你 5 呎內除你之外的目標時，你可以利用你的反應對攻擊檢定施加不利影響。你一定拿著盾牌。

隧道戰士

作為附贈動作，你可以進入防禦姿態，持續到你的下一個回合開始。當處於防禦姿態時，你可以在不使用反應的情況下進行藉機攻擊，並且可以使用你的反應對在你的攻擊範圍內移動超過 5 呎的生物進行近戰攻擊。

施法

到了第二級，你已經學會了透過冥想和祈禱來利用神聖魔法來像牧師一樣施展法術。有關施法的一般規則，請參閱第 10 章；有關聖武士法術列表，請參閱第 11 章。

準備和施法

聖騎士表格顯示了你必須施展法術的法術位數量。要施展你的一個 1 級或更高等級的聖武士法術，你必須消耗該法術等級或更高的一個槽位。當你完成長休後，你會重新獲得所有消耗的法術位。

你準備可供你施展的聖武士法術列表，從聖武士法術列表中進行選擇。當你這樣做時，選擇一定數量的聖武士法術，數量等於你的魅力調整值+你的聖武士等級的一半，向下舍入（至少一個法術）。這些法術必須屬於你有法術位的等級。

例如，如果你是 5 級聖騎士，則你有 4 個 1 級法術位和 2 個 2 級法術位。當魅力為 14 時，你準備的法術清單可以包括 4 個 1 級或 2 級法術的任意組合。如果你準備了 1 級法術來治療傷口，則可以使用 1 級或 2 級插槽來施放它。施展該法術並不會將其從你準備好的法術清單中刪除。

當你完成長時間的休息後，你可以改變你準備好的法術清單。準備一份新的聖武士法術清單需要花費時間進行祈禱和冥想：清單中的每個法術每個法術等級至少需要 1 分鐘。

施法能力

魅力是你對聖武士法術的施法能力，因為它們的力量源自於你堅定的信念。每當法術涉及你的施法能力時，你就使用你的魅力。此外，在為你施放的聖武士法術設定豁免 DC 以及使用該法術進行攻擊檢定時，你可以使用你的魅力調整值。

能力DC：8+熟練加值+魅力調整值

咒語

施法焦點

你可以使用聖徽（見第 5 章）作為聖騎士法術的施法焦點。
note.lvl02_details_en:
Divine Smite

Starting at 2nd level, when you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one spell slot to deal radiant damage to the target, in addition to the weapon's damage. The extra damage is 2d8 for a 1st-level spell slot, plus 1d8 for each spell level higher than 1st, to a maximum of 5d8. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is an undead or a fiend.

Fighting Style

You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose a fighting style from the list of optional features. You can't take the same Fighting Style option more than once, even if you get to choose again.

Choose one of the following:

Close Quarters Shooter

When making a ranged attack while you are within 5 feet of a hostile creature, you do not have disadvantage on the attack roll. Your ranged attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover against targets within 30 feet of you. You have a +1 bonus to attack rolls on ranged attacks.

Defense

While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

Dueling

When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

Great Weapon Fighting

When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll. The weapon must have the two-handed or versatile property for you to gain this benefit.

Mariner

As long as you are not wearing heavy armor or using a shield, you have a swimming speed and a climbing speed equal to your normal speed, and you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

Protection

When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll. You must be wielding a shield.

Tunnel Fighter

As a bonus action, you can enter a defensive stance that lasts until the start of your next turn. While in your defensive stance, you can make opportunity attacks without using your reaction, and you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against a creature that moves more than 5 feet while within your reach.

Spellcasting

By 2nd level, you have learned to draw on divine magic through meditation and prayer to cast spells as a cleric does. See chapter 10 for the general rules of spellcasting and chapter 11 for the paladin spell list.

Preparing and Casting Spells

The Paladin table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your spells. To cast one of your paladin spells of 1st level or higher, you must expend a slot of the spell's level or higher. You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a long rest.

You prepare the list of paladin spells that are available for you to cast, choosing from the paladin spell list. When you do so, choose a number of paladin spells equal to your Charisma modifier + half your paladin level, rounded down (minimum of one spell). The spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

For example, if you are a 5th-level paladin, you have four 1st-level and two 2nd-level spell slots. With a Charisma of 14, your list of prepared spells can include four spells of 1st or 2nd-level, in any combination. If you prepare the 1st-level spell cure wounds, you can cast it using a 1st-level or a 2nd-level slot. Casting the spell doesn't remove it from your list of prepared spells.

You can change your list of prepared spells when you finish a long rest. Preparing a new list of paladin spells requires time spent in prayer and meditation: at least 1 minute per spell level for each spell on your list.

Spellcasting Ability

Charisma is your spellcasting ability for your paladin spells, since their power derives from the strength of your convictions. You use your Charisma whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Charisma modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a paladin spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.

Ability DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + cha modifier

Spell

Spellcasting Focus

You can use a holy symbol (found in chapter 5) as a spellcasting focus for your paladin spells.
note.lvl03_details_zh:
神聖健康

到了第三級，流經你體內的神聖魔法使你對疾病免疫。

神聖誓言

當你達到第 3 級時，你就立下了永遠成為聖武士的誓言。到目前為止，你一直處於準備階段，致力於修道，但尚未發誓。現在你可以從可用的誓言清單中進行選擇。

你的選擇將授予你第 3 級以及第 7、15 和 20 級的功能。這些功能包括誓言咒語和通道神性功能。

誓言咒語

每個誓言都有一個相關咒語清單。你可以在誓言描述中指定的等級使用這些法術。一旦你獲得了誓言咒語，你就必須做好準備。誓言咒語不計入你每天可以準備的咒語數量。

如果你獲得的誓言法術沒有出現在聖武士法術列表中，那麼法術仍然是適合你的聖武士法術。

頻道神性

你的誓言可以讓你引導神聖能量來激發魔法效果。你的誓言提供的每個通道神性選項都解釋瞭如何使用它。

當你使用頻道神性時，你可以選擇要使用的選項。然後，你必須完成短暫或長時間的休息才能再次使用你的通道神性。

某些引導神性效果需要豁免檢定。當你使用此類效果時，DC 等於你的聖武士法術豁免 DC。

違背你的誓言

聖武士努力遵守最高的行為標準，但即使是最有道德的聖武士也難免犯錯。有時，正確的道路要求太高，有時，情況需要兩害相權取其輕，有時，情緒的熾熱會導致聖武士違背他或她的誓言。

違背誓言的聖武士通常會尋求與他或她有共同信仰的牧師或同階聖武士的赦免。聖武士可能會整夜守夜祈禱，以示懺悔，或採取快速或類似的自我否定行為。在懺悔和寬恕的儀式之後，聖武士重新開始。

如果聖武士故意違背自己的誓言並且沒有任何悔改的跡象，那麼後果可能會更加嚴重。根據 DM 的判斷，不知悔改的聖武士可能會被迫放棄這個職業並採用另一個職業，或者可能選擇《地下城主指南》中出現的破誓者聖武士選項。
note.lvl03_details_en:
Divine Health

By 3rd level, the divine magic flowing through you makes you immune to disease.

Sacred Oath

When you reach 3rd level, you swear the oath that binds you as a paladin forever. Up to this time you have been in a preparatory stage, committed to the path but not yet sworn to it. Now you choose from the list of available oaths.

Your choice grants you features at 3rd level and again at 7th, 15th, and 20th level. Those features include oath spells and the Channel Divinity feature.

Oath Spells

Each oath has a list of associated spells. You gain access to these spells at the leves specified in the oath description. Once you gain access to an oath spell, you always have it prepared. Oath spells don't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day.

If you gain an oath spell that doesn't appear on the paladin spell list, the spell is nonetheless a paladin spell for you.

Channel Divinity

Your oath allows you to channel divine energy to fuel magical effects. Each Channel Divinity option provided by your oath explains how to use it.

When you use your Channel Divinity, you choose which option to use. You must then finish a short or long rest to use your Channel Divinity again.

Some Channel Divinity effects require saving throws. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your paladin spell save DC.

Breaking Your Oath

A paladin tries to hold to the highest standards of conduct, but even the most virtuous paladin is fallible. Sometimes the right path proves too demanding, sometimes a situation calls for the lesser of two evils, and sometimes the heat of emotion causes a paladin to transgress his or her oath.

A paladin who has broken a vow typically seeks absolution from a cleric who shares his or her faith or from another paladin of the same order. The paladin might spend an all-night vigil in prayer as a sign of penitence, or undertake a fast or similar act of self-denial. After a rite of confession and forgiveness, the paladin starts fresh.

If a paladin willfully violates his or her oath and shows no sign of repentance, the consequences can be more serious. At the DM's discretion, an impenitent paladin might be forced to abandon this class and adopt another, or perhaps to take the Oathbreaker paladin option that appears in the Dungeon Master's Guide.

note.lvl01_details_zh:
熟練

• 護甲：輕甲、中甲、盾牌
• 武器：簡易武器、軍用武器
• 技能：從動物馴養、運動、察言觀色、調查、自然、觀察、隱匿、生存中選擇三項

起始裝備

• 鱗甲或皮甲
• 兩把短劍，或兩把簡易近戰武器
• 地城探索者套組或探險者套組
• 長弓與裝有 20 支箭的箭袋

宿敵

選擇一類宿敵：異怪、野獸、天界生物、構裝生物、龍、元素生物、精類、邪魔、巨人、怪獸、泥怪、植物或不死生物；也可改選兩類類人生物。

追蹤宿敵的感知（生存）檢定，以及回想其相關資訊的智力檢定具有優勢。若宿敵會說話，還可學會其使用的一種語言。

自然探索者

選擇一種偏好地形：極地、海岸、沙漠、森林、草原、山地、沼澤或幽暗地域。進行與該地形有關的智力或感知檢定時，若使用熟練技能，熟練加值加倍。

在偏好地形旅行一小時以上時：

• 困難地形不會減緩團隊的旅行速度
• 除非受到魔法影響，團隊不會迷路
• 即使從事覓食、導航或追蹤等其他活動，仍會對危險保持警戒
• 獨自行動時，可用正常速度隱匿移動
• 覓食時可找到兩倍食物
• 追蹤生物時，可得知其確切數量、體型，以及經過此處多久

Starting Equipment

• Scale mail or leather armor
• Two shortswords or two simple melee weapons
• A dungeoneer's pack or explorer's pack
• A longbow and a quiver of 20 arrows

Favored Enemy

Choose one favored enemy type: aberrations, beasts, celestials, constructs, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, giants, monstrosities, oozes, plants, or undead. Alternatively, choose two types of humanoids.

You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track favored enemies and on Intelligence checks to recall information about them. If your favored enemies speak a language, you also learn one language they use.

Natural Explorer

Choose one favored terrain: arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, or the Underdark. On Intelligence or Wisdom checks related to that terrain, double your proficiency bonus if you use a proficient skill.

When traveling through favored terrain for at least 1 hour:

• Difficult terrain does not slow your group's travel
• Your group cannot become lost except by magical means
• You remain alert to danger while performing another activity, such as foraging, navigating, or tracking
• When traveling alone, you can move stealthily at a normal pace
• You find twice as much food while foraging
• While tracking, you learn the creatures' exact number, sizes, and how long ago they passed through the area

決鬥

水手

只要你沒有穿著重甲或使用盾牌，你的游泳速度和攀爬速度就等於你的正常速度，而且你的AC獲得+1加值。

隧道戰士

作為附贈動作，你可以進入防禦姿態，持續到你的下一個回合開始。當處於防禦姿態時，你可以在不使用反應的情況下進行藉機攻擊，並且可以使用你的反應對在你的攻擊範圍內移動超過 5 呎的生物進行近戰攻擊。

雙武器戰鬥

當你進行雙武器戰鬥時，你可以將你的能力調整值加到第二次攻擊的傷害上。

施法

當你達到第二級時，你已經學會了使用自然的魔法本質來施展法術，就像德魯伊一樣。有關施法的一般規則，請參閱第 10 章；有關遊俠法術列表，請參閱第 11 章。

法術槽

遊俠表顯示了你需要多少個法術位來施放 1 級及更高級別的法術。要施展其中一個法術，你必須消耗該法術等級或更高的槽位。當你完成長休後，你會重新獲得所有消耗的法術位。

例如，如果你知道 1 級法術「動物友誼」並且有可用的 1 級和 2 級法術插槽，則可以使用任一插槽施放動物友誼。

1級以上的已知法術

你知道遊俠法術清單中你選擇的兩個 1 級法術。

遊俠表的已知法術列顯示你何時學習了更多你選擇的遊俠法術。這些法術中的每一個都必須屬於你有法術位的等級。例如，當你在本課程中達到5級時，你可以學習一個1級或2級的新法術。

此外，當你獲得該等級的等級時，你可以選擇你所知道的遊俠法術之一，並將其替換為遊俠法術列表中的另一個法術，該法術也必須屬於你擁有法術位的等級。

施法能力

智慧是你對遊俠法術的施法能力，因為你的魔法依賴你對大自然的協調。每當咒語涉及到你的施法能力時，你就使用你的智慧。此外，在為你施放的遊俠法術設定豁免 DC 以及使用遊俠法術進行攻擊檢定時，你可以使用你的感知調整值。

能力DC：8+熟練加值+感知調整值

note.lvl02_details_en:
Fighting Style

At 2nd level, you adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following options: Archery, Defense, Dueling, Mariner, or Two-Weapon Fighting. You can't take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if you later get to choose again.

Choose one of the following:

Archery

You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

Close Quarters Shooter

When making a ranged attack while you are within 5 feet of a hostile creature, you do not have disadvantage on the attack roll. Your ranged attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover against targets within 30 feet of you. You have a +1 bonus to attack rolls on ranged attacks.

Defense

While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

Dueling

When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

Mariner

As long as you are not wearing heavy armor or using a shield, you have a swimming speed and a climbing speed equal to your normal speed, and you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

Tunnel Fighter

As a bonus action, you can enter a defensive stance that lasts until the start of your next turn. While in your defensive stance, you can make opportunity attacks without using your reaction, and you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against a creature that moves more than 5 feet while within your reach.

Two-Weapon Fighting

When you engage in two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.

Spellcasting

By the time you reach 2nd level, you have learned to use the magical essence of nature to cast spells, much as a druid does. See chapter 10 for the general rules of spellcasting and chapter 11 for the ranger spell list.

Spell Slots

The Ranger table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your spells of 1st level and higher. To cast one of these spells, you must expend a slot of the spell's level or higher. You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a long rest.

For example, if you know the 1st-level spell animal friendship and have a 1st-level and a 2nd-level spell slot available, you can cast animal friendship using either slot.

Spells Known of 1st Level and Higher

You know two 1st-level spells of your choice from the ranger spell list.

The Spells Known column of the Ranger table shows when you learn more ranger spells of your choice. Each of these spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For instance, when you reach 5th level in this class, you can learn one new spell of 1st or 2nd level.

Additionally, when you gain a level in this class, you can choose one of the ranger spells you know and replace it with another spell from the ranger spell list, which also must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

Spellcasting Ability

Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your ranger spells, since your magic draws on your attunement to nature. You use your Wisdom whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Wisdom modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a ranger spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.

Ability DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + wis modifier

note.lvl03_details_zh:
遊俠原型

在第三級，你從可用原型清單中選擇一個你努力模仿的原型。你的選擇授予第 3 級的功能，以及第 7、11 和 15 級的功能。

原始意識

從第 3 級開始，你可以使用你的動作並消耗一個遊俠法術位來將你的意識集中在你周圍的區域。在你花費的每級法術位1分鐘內，你可以感知以下類型的生物是否存在於你的1英里範圍內（如果你在你喜歡的地形中，則在最多6英里範圍內）：異獸、天體、龍、元素、精類、惡魔和不死生物。此功能不會透露生物的位置或數量。
note.lvl03_details_en:
Ranger Archetype

At 3rd level, you choose an archetype that you strive to emulate from the list of available archetypes. Your choice grants features at 3rd level, and again at 7th, 11th, and 15th level.

Primeval Awareness

Beginning at 3rd level, you can use your action and expend one ranger spell slot to focus your awareness on the region around you. For 1 minute per level of the spell slot you expend, you can sense whether the following types of creatures are present within 1 mile of you (or within up to 6 miles if you are in your favored terrain): aberrations, celestials, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead. This feature doesn't reveal the creatures' location or number.
note.lvl04_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到4級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此功能將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl04_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 4th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl05_details_zh:
額外攻擊

從第 5 級開始，每當你在自己的回合中採取攻擊行動時，你可以攻擊兩次，而不是一次。
note.lvl05_details_en:
Extra Attack

Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
note.lvl06_details_zh:
宿敵和自然探險家的改進

在第 6 級，你獲得了額外的偏好地形。

在第 6 級，你可以選擇一個額外的宿敵以及相關的語言。你的選擇應該反映你在冒險中遇到的怪物的類型。
note.lvl06_details_en:
Favored Enemy and Natural Explorer improvements

At 6th level, you gain an additional favored terrain.

At 6th level, you choose one additional favored enemy, as well as an associated language. Your choice should reflect the types of monsters you have encountered on your adventures.
note.lvl07_details_zh:
遊俠原型特徵

在第 7 級，你獲得了你的遊俠原型賦予你的一個功能。
note.lvl07_details_en:
Ranger Archetype feature

At 7th level, you gain a feature granted to you by your Ranger Archetype.
note.lvl08_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到8級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。正常情況下，你不能使用此功能將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。

大地的步伐

從第 8 級開始，穿越非魔法的困難地形不需要額外的移動。你也可以穿過非魔法植物，而不會被它們減慢速度，如果它們有刺、刺或類似的危險，也不會受到它們的傷害。

此外，你在對抗那些透過魔法創造或操縱來阻礙移動的植物（例如由糾纏法術創造的植物）時具有優勢。
note.lvl08_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 8th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.

Land's Stride

Starting at 8th level, moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. You can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement, such those created by the entangle spell.
note.lvl10_details_zh:
隱藏在眾目睽睽之下

從第 10 級開始，你可以花 1 分鐘為自己創建偽裝。你必須能夠接觸到新鮮的泥土、污垢、植物、煙灰和其他天然材料來製作你的偽裝。

一旦你以這種方式偽裝，你可以透過將自己壓在至少與你一樣高和寬的堅固表面上來隱藏，例如樹或牆。只要你待在那裡不移動或採取行動，你的敏捷（潛行）檢定就會獲得+10加值。一旦你移動或採取行動或反應，你必須再次偽裝自己才能獲得這種好處。

自然探索者改進

你獲得了額外的有利地形。
note.lvl10_details_en:
Hide in Plain Sight

Starting at 10th level, you can spend 1 minute creating camouflage for yourself. You must have access to fresh mud, dirt, plants, soot, and other naturally occurring materials with which to create your camouflage.

Once you are camouflaged in this way, you can try to hide by pressing yourself up against a solid surface, such as a tree or wall, that is at least as tall and wide as you are. You gain a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks as long as you remain there without moving or taking actions. Once you move or take an action or a reaction, you must camouflage yourself again to gain this benefit.

Natural Explorer improvement

You gain an additional favored terrain.

在第 11 級，你獲得了遊俠原型賦予你的一項功能。

Ranger Archetype feature

At 11th level, you gain a feature granted to you by your Ranger Archetype.

宿敵改進

在第 14 級，你可以選擇一個額外的宿敵以及相關的語言。你的選擇應該反映你在冒險中遇到的怪物的類型。
note.lvl14_details_en:
Vanish

Starting at 14th level, you can use the Hide action as a bonus action on your turn. Also, you can't be tracked by nonmagical means, unless you choose to leave a trail.

Favored Enemy improvement

At 14th level, you choose one additional favored enemy, as well as an associated language. Your choice should reflect the types of monsters you have encountered on your adventures.

遊俠原型特徵

在第 15 級，你獲得了遊俠原型賦予你的功能。

野性感官

18級時，你獲得了超自然的感官，可以幫助你對抗看不見的生物。當你攻擊一個你看不到的生物時，你看不到它不會為你的攻擊檢定帶來不利。你也知道你周圍 30 呎內任何隱形生物的位置，前提是該生物沒有對你隱藏，而且你沒有失明或失聰。
note.lvl18_details_en:
Feral Senses

At 18th level, you gain preternatural senses that help you fight creatures you can't see. When you attack a creature you can't see, your inability to see it doesn't impose disadvantage on your attack rolls against it. You are also aware of the location of any invisible creature within 30 feet of you, provided that the creature isn't hidden from you and you aren't blinded or deafened.
note.lvl19_details_zh:
能力值提升

note.lvl20_details_zh:
殺敵者

20級時，你將成為無與倫比的敵人獵人。在你的每個回合中，你可以將你的感知調整值加到你對你最喜歡的敵人之一的攻擊檢定或傷害檢定。你可以選擇在擲骰之前或之後、但在應用擲骰的任何效果之前使用此功能。
note.lvl20_details_en:
Foe Slayer

At 20th level, you become an unparalleled hunter of your enemies. Once on each of your turns, you can add your Wisdom modifier to the attack roll or the damage roll of an attack you make against one of your favored enemies. You can choose to use this feature before or after the roll, but before any effects of the roll are applied.

note.lvl01_details_zh:
簡介

浪客可能是盜賊、刺客，也可能有其他各式各樣的身分。他們擅長拆除陷阱與竊取財物，往往能在神不知鬼不覺間取走珠寶與錢幣。

熟練

• 護甲：輕甲
• 武器：簡易武器、手弩、長劍、細劍、短劍
• 工具：盜賊工具
• 技能：從體操、運動、欺瞞、察言觀色、威嚇、調查、觀察、表演、遊說、巧手、隱匿中選擇四項

起始裝備

• 細劍或短劍
• 短弓與裝有 20 支箭的箭袋，或短劍
• 竊賊套組、地城探索者套組或探險者套組
• 皮甲、兩把匕首與盜賊工具

專精

選擇兩項已熟練的技能，或一項已熟練的技能與盜賊工具。使用所選技能或工具進行檢定時，熟練加值加倍。

偷襲

每回合一次，當你使用靈巧武器或遠程武器命中，且該次攻擊檢定具有優勢時，可額外造成 1d6 傷害。如果目標 5 呎內有另一名未陷入失能狀態的敵人，且你的攻擊檢定不具有劣勢，則無須具有優勢也能使用偷襲。額外傷害會隨浪客等級提高。

賊話

你理解並能使用賊話。以賊話傳遞訊息所需的時間是一般對話的四倍；你也能理解用來傳達簡短訊息的秘密標記與符號。
note.lvl01_details_en:
Overview

Rogues may be thieves, assassins, or known by any number of other names. They excel at disabling traps and stealing valuables, often making off with jewels and coins without anyone noticing.

Proficiencies

• Armor: Light armor
• Weapons: Simple weapons, hand crossbows, longswords, rapiers, and shortswords
• Tools: Thieves' tools
• Skills: Choose four from Acrobatics, Athletics, Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Perception, Performance, Persuasion, Sleight of Hand, and Stealth

Starting Equipment

• A rapier or shortsword
• A shortbow and a quiver of 20 arrows, or a shortsword
• A burglar's pack, dungeoneer's pack, or explorer's pack
• Leather armor, two daggers, and thieves' tools

Expertise

Choose two proficient skills, or one proficient skill and your thieves' tools. Double your proficiency bonus for checks made with the chosen skills or tool.

Sneak Attack

Once per turn, when you hit with a finesse or ranged weapon and have advantage on the attack roll, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage. You do not need advantage if another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it, that enemy is not incapacitated, and your attack roll does not have disadvantage. The extra damage increases with your rogue level.

Thieves' Cant

You understand and can use Thieves' Cant. Conveying a message in Thieves' Cant takes four times as long as ordinary speech. You also understand secret signs and symbols used to communicate short messages.
note.lvl02_details_zh:
狡猾的行動

從第 2 級開始，你的快速思維和敏捷性使你能夠快速行動和行動。你可以在戰鬥的每個回合中採取獎勵行動。此操作只能用於執行「衝刺」、「脫離」或「隱藏」操作。
note.lvl02_details_en:
Cunning Action

Starting at 2nd level, your quick thinking and agility allow you to move and act quickly. You can take a bonus action on each of your turns in combat. This action can be used only to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.
note.lvl03_details_zh:
流氓原型

在第 3 級，你可以從可用原型清單中選擇一個在練習盜賊能力時效仿的原型。你的原型選擇將授予你第 3 級的功能，然後再授予你第 9、13 和 17 級的功能。
note.lvl03_details_en:
Roguish Archetype

At 3rd level, you choose an archetype that you emulate in the exercise of your rogue abilities from the list of available archetypes. Your archetype choice grants you features at 3rd level and then again at 9th, 13th, and 17th level.
note.lvl04_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到4級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。通常，你不能使用此功能將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl04_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 4th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl05_details_zh:
不可思議的閃避

從第 5 級開始，當你看到的攻擊者攻擊你時，你可以使用你的反應將攻擊對你造成的傷害減半。
note.lvl05_details_en:
Uncanny Dodge

Starting at 5th level, when an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.
note.lvl06_details_zh:
專業知識

在第 6 級，你可以選擇另外兩項你的熟練程度（技能或盜賊工具）來獲得專業知識的好處。
note.lvl06_details_en:
Expertise

At 6th level, you can choose two more of your proficiencies (in skills or with thieves' tools) to gain the benefit of Expertise.
note.lvl07_details_zh:
閃避

從 7 級開始，你可以靈活地躲避某些區域效果，例如紅龍的火焰吐息或冰風暴法術。當你受到允許你進行敏捷豁免檢定僅受到一半傷害的效果時，如果你豁免檢定成功，你將不會受到任何傷害，如果你失敗，你只會受到一半傷害。
note.lvl07_details_en:
Evasion

Beginning at 7th level, you can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain area effects, such as a red dragon's fiery breath or an ice storm spell. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.
note.lvl08_details_zh:
能力值提升

當你達到8級時，你可以將你選擇的一項能力得分增加2，或者你可以將你選擇的兩項能力得分增加1。正常情況下，你不能使用此功能將能力得分增加到20以上。

如果你的 DM 允許使用專長，你可以改為選擇專長。
note.lvl08_details_en:
Ability Score Improvement

When you reach 8th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.
note.lvl09_details_zh:

note.lvl01_details_zh:
熟練

• 武器：匕首、飛鏢、投石索、長棍、輕弩
• 技能：從奧秘、欺瞞、察言觀色、威嚇、遊說、宗教中選擇兩項

起始裝備

• 輕弩與 20 支弩矢，或任一簡易武器

• 地城探索者套組或探險者套組

施法

• 施法能力：魅力
• 法術豁免 DC：8 + 熟練加值 + 魅力調整值
• 法術攻擊加值：熟練加值 + 魅力調整值
• 戲法：從術師法術表選擇四個
• 1 環法術：從術師法術表選擇兩個
• 升級時，可將一個已知法術替換為另一個符合條件的術師法術
• 可使用秘法法器作為施法法器

術法起源

選擇「龍族血脈」或「狂野魔法」作為術法起源；它們會在不同等級賦予不同能力。

龍族血脈

龍族祖先

1 級時選擇一種龍族祖先及其傷害類型。你能讀寫並說龍語；與龍互動時，若進行魅力檢定，任何適用的熟練加值均加倍。

龍族韌性

1 級時生命值上限額外增加 1，此後每升一級再增加 1。未穿著護甲時，護甲等級為 13 + 敏捷調整值。

狂野魔法

狂野魔法潮湧

1 級起，當你施放 1 環或更高環級的術師法術後，DM 可要求你擲 d20；若擲出 1，則擲 d100 並依狂野魔法潮湧表產生效果。每回合最多進行一次此判定。

狂野魔法潮湧表

{{table:wild_magic_table}}

混亂浪潮

每次長休間，可使自己的一次攻擊檢定、能力檢定或豁免具有優勢。使用後，DM 可在你施放 1 環或更高環級的術師法術時，直接要求你擲狂野魔法潮湧表；完成後便恢復此能力。
note.lvl01_details_en:
Proficiencies

• Weapons: Daggers, darts, slings, quarterstaffs, and light crossbows
• Skills: Choose two from Arcana, Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Persuasion, and Religion

Starting Equipment

• A light crossbow and 20 bolts, or any simple weapon
• A component pouch or arcane focus
• A dungeoneer's pack or explorer's pack
• Two daggers

Spellcasting

• Spellcasting Ability: Charisma
• Spell Save DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier
• Spell Attack Modifier: proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier
• Cantrips: Choose four from the sorcerer spell list
• 1st-Level Spells: Choose two from the sorcerer spell list
• When you gain a level, you can replace one known spell with another eligible sorcerer spell
• You can use an arcane focus as a spellcasting focus

Sorcerous Origin

Choose Draconic Bloodline or Wild Magic as your sorcerous origin. Each grants features at different levels.

Draconic Bloodline

Dragon Ancestor

At 1st level, choose a draconic ancestor and its associated damage type. You can speak, read, and write Draconic. When making a Charisma check while interacting with dragons, double any proficiency bonus that applies.

Draconic Resilience

At 1st level, your hit point maximum increases by 1 and increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level. While not wearing armor, your Armor Class equals 13 + Dexterity modifier.

Wild Magic

Wild Magic Surge

Starting at 1st level, after you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, the DM can have you roll a d20. On a 1, roll a d100 and apply the corresponding result from the Wild Magic Surge table. This check can occur at most once per turn.

Wild Magic Surge Table

{{table:wild_magic_table}}

Tides of Chaos

Once per long rest, you can gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. After you use this feature, the DM can have you roll directly on the Wild Magic Surge table when you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher; after resolving the surge, you regain this feature.
note.lvl02_details_zh:
魔法字體

在第二級，你將挖掘自己內心深處的魔法泉源。這個泉源以術法點為代表，可以讓你創造出各種魔法效果

術法點

你有 2 點術法點，每次升級時都會額外獲得 1 點，在 20 級時最多獲得 20 點。你擁有的術法點永遠不會多於表中所示的你的等級。當你完成長時間的休息後，你會恢復所有消耗的術法點。

靈活鑄造

你可以使用術法點來獲得額外的法術位，或是犧牲法術位來獲得額外的術法點。當你達到更高的水平時，你會學習其他使用術法點的方法。

創建法術位

你可以將未消耗的術法點轉化為法術位，作為你回合中的一項附贈動作。創建的法術位在長休結束時消失。建立法術位表顯示了創建給定等級的法術位的成本。你可以創造等級不高於5級的法術位。

|法術位等級 |術法點成本|
| --- | --- |
|第一 | 2 |
|第二 | 3 |
|第三 | 5 |
|第四 | 6 |
|第五 | 7 |

將法術位轉換為術法點

作為你回合的附贈動作，你可以消耗一個法術位並獲得等於法術位等級的術法點。
note.lvl02_details_en:
Font of Magic

At 2nd level, you tap into a deep wellspring of magic within yourself. This wellspring is represented by sorcery points, which allow you to create a variety of magical effects

Sorcery Points

You have 2 sorcery points, and you gain one additional point every time you level up, to a maximum of 20 at level 20. You can never have more sorcery points than shown on the table for your level. You regain all spent sorcery points when you finish a long rest.

Flexible Casting

You can use your sorcery points to gain additional spell slots, or sacrifice spell slots to gain additional sorcery points. You learn other ways to use your sorcery points as you reach higher levels.

Creating Spell Slots

You can transform unexpended sorcery points into one spell slot as a bonus action on your turn. The created spell slots vanish at the end of a long rest. The Creating Spell Slots table shows the cost of creating a spell slot of a given level. You can create spell slots no higher in level than 5th.

| Spell Slot Level | Sorcery Point Cost |
| --- | --- |
| 1st | 2 |
| 2nd | 3 |
| 3rd | 5 |
| 4th | 6 |
| 5th | 7 |

Converting a Spell Slot to Sorcery Points

As a bonus action on your turn, you can expend one spell slot and gain a number of sorcery points equal to the slot's level.
note.lvl03_details_zh:
超魔法

在第 3 級，你獲得了改變你的法術以滿足你的需要的能力。你可以選擇以下超魔法選項中的兩個。在第 10 級和第 17 級時你會獲得另一個。

除非另有說明，當你施展法術時，你只能使用一個超魔法選項。

選擇以下選項之一：

謹慎法術

當你施放一個迫使其他生物進行豁免的法術時，你可以保護其中一些生物免受該法術的全部力量的影響。為此，你花費 1 個術法點並選擇數量不超過你的魅力調整值的生物（最少一個生物）。被選中的生物自動成功通過該法術的豁免檢定。

遠距法術

當你施展射程為 5 呎或以上的法術時，你可以花費 1 點術法點來使法術射程加倍。

當你施展具有接觸範圍的法術時，你可以花費 1 個術法點來使法術的範圍達到 30 呎。

強化法術

當你投擲法術傷害時，你可以花費 1 個術法點來重新投擲一定數量的傷害骰子，最多可達你的魅力調整值（最少 1 個）。你必須使用新的擲骰結果。

即使你在施法期間已經使用了不同的超魔法選項，你也可以使用強化法術。

延長法術

當你施展持續時間為 1 分鐘或更長的法術時，你可以花費 1 個術法點來使其持續時間加倍，最長持續時間為 24 小時。

強化法術

當你施放一個法術，迫使一個生物進行豁免檢定來抵抗其效果時，你可以花費 3 點魔法值，使一個目標在對抗該法術的第一次豁免檢定中處於劣勢。

加速法術

當你施放一個施法時間為 1 個動作的法術時，你可以花費 2 個術法點將施法時間改為該施法的 1 個附贈動作。

無聲法術

當你施展法術時，你可以花費 1 個法術點來施展它，而無需任何軀體或言語成分。

雙生法術

當你施展的法術沒有自身範圍並且無法以該法術當前等級瞄準多個生物時，你可以花費等於該法術等級的術法點來用相同法術瞄準範圍內的第二個生物（如果該法術是戲法，則為1術法點）。
note.lvl03_details_en:
Metamagic

At 3rd level, you gain the ability to twist your spells to suit your needs. You gain two of the following Metamagic options of your choice. You gain another one at 10th and 17th level.

You can use only one Metamagic option on a spell when you cast it, unless otherwise noted.

Choose one of the following:

Careful Spell

When you cast a spell that forces other creatures to make a saving throw, you can protect some of those creatures from the spell's full force. To do so, you spend 1 sorcery point and choose a number of those creatures up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature). A chosen creature automatically succeeds on its saving throw against the spell.

Distant Spell

When you cast a spell that has a range of 5 feet or greater, you can spend 1 sorcery point to double the range of the spell.

When you cast a spell that has a range of touch, you can spend 1 sorcery point to make the range of the spell 30 feet.

Empowered Spell

When you roll damage for a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to reroll a number of the damage dice up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). You must use the new rolls.

You can use Empowered Spell even if you have already used a different Metamagic option during the casting of the spell.

Extended Spell

When you cast a spell that has a duration of 1 minute or longer, you can spend 1 sorcery point to double its duration, to a maximum duration of 24 hours.

Heightened Spell

When you cast a spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw to resist its effects, you can spend 3 sorcery points to give one target of the spell disadvantage on its first saving throw made against the spell.

Quickened Spell

When you cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, you can spend 2 sorcery points to change the casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.

Subtle Spell

When you cast a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to cast it without any somatic or verbal components.

Twinned Spell

When you cast a spell that doesn't have a range of self and is incapable of targeting more than one creature at the spell's current level, you can spend a number of sorcery points equal to the spell's level to target a second creature in range with the same spell (1 sorcery point if the spell is a cantrip).
